Precise control of the SO-101 arm · Part 5 of 8 · HardwareOctober 5, 202619 min read

A printed pen holder for measuring SO-101 drawing error

I want to see my SO-101 trajectory errors as ink on paper. For that, the pen must not add an error of its own. I made five holder designs. The one I release is a printed sleeve that slides onto the stock gripper: 4 printed parts, nothing to buy, any pen from 8 to 13 mm.
